description: This file contains an abstract test runner class for Orleans transaction concurrency tests, specifically tailored for xUnit testing framework. It defines test methods for shared grain transactions, transaction chains, and transaction trees, utilizing attributes to allow for test skipping and parameterization.

classes.name: TransactionConcurrencyTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner, implementing xUnit specific test methods for various transaction concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: SingleSharedGrainTest
methods.description: Runs a test where two transactions share a single grain, parameterized by grain state.

methods.name: TransactionChainTest
methods.description: Runs a test for a chain of dependent transactions, parameterized by grain state.

methods.name: TransactionTreeTest
methods.description: Runs a test for a transaction tree involving multiple grains, parameterized by grain state.
